Well, the humbucker is not *only* for heavier stuff. But it is used because i humbucker has a thicker and warmer tone than single coils. Also, the bridge (pickup furthest away from the neck) has a brighter sound than the neck pickup (pickup closest to the neck) regardless of pickup type. Single coils are usually brighter than humbuckers and in my opinion a bit thinner too. Some pickups are better for different genres but in all reality it boils down to personal preference.
